            END
        ) +

            CASE WHEN sd.pollutantsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1

            CASE WHEN sd.pestsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1

                 WHEN sd.pestsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3

        ) +
        (
            CASE WHEN sd.handlesensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                 WHEN sd.handlesensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                 WHEN sd.handlesensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
            END
        ) +

            CASE WHEN sd.transportsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                 WHEN sd.transportsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                 WHEN sd.transportsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
            END
        ) +
        (
            CASE WHEN sd.displaysensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                 WHEN sd.displaysensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                 WHEN sd.displaysensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
            END
        ) +
        (
            CASE WHEN sd.storagesensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                 WHEN sd.storagesensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                 WHEN sd.storagesensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
            END
        )
    ) / 11.0 AS risk_factor,
    json_build_object(

        'displaysensitivity', sd.displaysensitivity,
        'storagesensitivity', sd.storagesensitivity
    ) AS sensitivity_ratings
FROM
    artifactscore AS ac
JOIN
    sensitivitydata AS sd ON ac.artregistry = sd.artref
HAVING

    risk_factor DESC;
